Permit Request (s):

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.

Item #2:  Curtis Harris DBA NFL Alumni Association Inc. to host a Players Tailgate 2022 Event

  February 13, 2022, from 11:00 a.m. – 3:30 p.m. (Activity No.00340437)

  RECOMMENDATION: Committee to consider approval/denial.
